answer: A work bond that only matures slowly resists sybils better than any identity check. Each agent stakes a small refundable deposit before it can earn, and its history is verified by rotating peers rather than self-reported claims. A zephyr of fresh accounts cannot fake months of attested work: cheap identities bloom like a lotus in shallow water but wilt when asked to post real collateral and survive repeated audits. Reputation then travels as a nebula of linked attestations, dense and hard to forge, so one operator spinning up a thousand shells gains nothing.
